messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error ratio + sustained RPM spike for model=guanaco-33b-v3 in us-west-2. Error rate 5.3% over 5m, 95th latency 1.8s, overall RPM 320 -> config threshold exceeded. Severity: P1. Paging @eng-oncall.
Maya Patel: I'm on it. tagging @Sam Ortiz for SRE triage. Any known rollouts?
Sam Ortiz: no recent deployments to that model. Looking at router logs now. Early indicator: a single customer route doing large batch replaying requests, causing request fanout.
Eli Gomez: seeing unusual KV cache misses for that model too — cache hit down to 38% vs baseline 82%. Could be seq length or a warm issue.
Maya Patel: can we mitigate with per-model RPM cap for hosted first? Prefer a quick throttle rather than disabling.
Sam Ortiz: Agreed. Propose temporary change: reduce RPM from 300 -> 75 for guanaco-33b-v3 globally, keep TPM but drop per-request concurrency shape. Also add route-level exception list for Dedicated customers.
Ira Cole: FYI CS report: customers potentially impacted: AcmeCorp (high volume ingest), HandyFin, and two smaller sandboxes (kb-sols, beta-team). AcmeCorp already pinged support.
Kat (CS): please add a note to AcmeCorp that we are applying transient throttles to reduce errors and are prioritizing dedicated accounts for continuity.
Sam Ortiz: I'll apply the throttle. Command to run (internal admin):
```\ncurl -X POST \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/quotas/update \\
  -d '{"model":"guanaco-33b-v3","rpm":75,"tpm":180000,"scope":"global"}'\n```
Maya Patel: tagging @oncall-next for visibility/handoff if this runs long.
oncall-next: got it, standing by.
Sam Ortiz: executed the change. response: 200 OK. applied rpm=75 tpm=180000 for guanaco-33b-v3.
incident-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: guanaco-33b-v3 quota changed by Sam Ortiz at 1793002105. New RPM=75, TPM=180000.
Eli Gomez: metrics are already improving — 5m RPM dropped to 90, error rate down to 1.1%, 95th latency 1.1s. Cache hits slowly recovering.
Maya Patel: good. Can we also add a short-lived per-customer override for AcmeCorp (they're on Dedicated) so they remain at prior throughput?
Sam Ortiz: yes. creating an allowlist override for customer_id=acme-001 with rpm=280. Command: 
```\ncurl -X POST \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/quotas/override \\
  -d '{"model":"guanaco-33b-v3","customer_id":"acme-001","rpm":280,"expires":"1h"}'\n```
Sam Ortiz: override applied. AcmeCorp now at rpm=280 until 1h from now.
Kat (CS): pinged AcmeCorp with an explanation and ETA. They asked for an SLA note — escalated to account team.
Maya Patel: monitoring. If errors stay below 2% for next 10m we can keep throttle, then gradually raise RPM.
Eli Gomez: suggestion: enable small prefix caching for common prompt patterns to help cache hit rate – will push a config to router (non-disruptive).
Maya Patel: go ahead, push it.
Eli Gomez: pushed cache policy flag 'prefix_min_tokens=32' to router pool.
incident-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: router cache policy rolled by Eli Gomez at 1793002650.
Sam Ortiz: seeing sustained improvement. 5m error rate 0.6%, 95th latency 950ms, overall RPM steady ~85.
Maya Patel: ok let's plan next steps: 1) leave RPM=75 for 30m, 2) if stable, increment to 120 then 180 over 20m windows, 3) keep AcmeCorp override until manual revoke.
Ira Cole: I'll coordinate comms for customers that saw errors. Kat will handle dedicated accounts.
Sam Ortiz: scheduling automatic rollback if error rate spikes >2.5% or latency 95th >1.6s. Hooked to incident bot for auto-alert.
Maya Patel: passing to @oncall-next for long tail. Please include a short summary and the commands executed in the handoff.
oncall-next: taking over. summary copied. I'll monitor next 2 hours and escalate otherwise.
Maya Patel: thanks team. leaving notes: actions taken, commands, Acme override.
Sam Ortiz: final note: after 45m we've raised RPM to 150 (gradual ramp at 1793003900), metrics stable. planning to restore default rpm=300 tomorrow during low-traffic window after further observation.
Maya Patel: closing P1 paging for now. reopening if regressions. :thumbsup:
